"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Our common civic culture is grounded in the values of work, family, personal responsibility, individual liberty, and faith.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"More of the world's citizens live in freedom than ever before.",
